raw:
```sql
SELECT 
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN c.Continent = 'Asia' THEN ch.population END) AS DOUBLE) / 
  NULLIF(CAST(SUM(ch.population) AS DOUBLE), 0)
FROM main.country_history ch
JOIN main.country c ON ch.code = c.Code
WHERE ch.effective_month = '2026-03'
```
